t: Rocky Mountain National Park Stargazing | Visit Grand County
s: November 4, 2025 - Ranger-led programs are one of the coolest ways to stargaze in Rocky Mountain National Park. In late summer (the 2025 event has passed, the next event will be in 2026) the National Park Service holds an Astronomy Festival with special guest presenters at the Kawuneeche and Beaver Meadows visitor centers, as well as telescope-viewing activities at the East Inlet Trailhead and Fall River Visitor Center. There are also night-sky programs throughout the year, including Astronomy in the Park sessions in summer and monthly full-moon snowshoe walks in winter.
